title: Support-Guided Triadic Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Dialogue with LVLMs
title_zh: Support-Guided Triadic Decoding：缓解 LVLM 多模态对话中的幻觉
abstract_en: In multimodal multi-turn dialogue, dialogue history plays a dual role: reliable responses provide useful context for subsequent turns, whereas hallucinated responses can propagate errors across turns. Existing training-free methods globally adjust the effect of dialogue history on generation, making it difficult to suppress misleading information without weakening useful context. To address this trade-off, we introduce Support-Guided Triadic Decoding (SGTD), a training-free framework that selectively controls the influence of unreliable history and fuses complementary predictions during decoding. Specifically, Historical Answer Support Estimation measures the visual support of historical responses against type-matched alternatives and identifies low-support content that may mislead later generation. Support-Targeted Attention Intervention then weakens the influence of this content while preserving the surrounding dialogue, producing a support-refined prediction. Triadic Decoding combines this prediction with the full-history prediction and answer-free visual evidence, while the Support-Adaptive Plausibility Constraint filters implausible tokens using visual agreement and historical support. Experiments on MMHalSnowball and VisDiaHalBench across representative LVLMs show that SGTD consistently achieves the highest accuracy under hallucinated histories while preserving the benefits of factual context.
abstract_zh: 在多模态多轮对话中，可靠的历史回答能为后续轮次提供有用的上下文，而含有幻觉的回答则可能导致错误逐轮传播。现有免训练方法通常整体调节对话历史对生成的影响，因此难以在抑制误导信息的同时保留有效上下文。为此，论文提出免训练框架 Support-Guided Triadic Decoding（SGTD）。首先，Historical Answer Support Estimation 将历史回答与同类型的备选回答进行比较，估计图像对历史回答的支持程度，识别可能误导后续生成的低支持度内容。随后，Support-Targeted Attention Intervention 选择性削弱这些内容的影响，同时保留其余对话上下文，得到修正后的预测。Triadic Decoding 在解码时融合修正后的预测、基于完整历史的预测和不依赖历史回答的视觉证据，并通过 Support-Adaptive Plausibility Constraint 结合视觉一致性与历史回答的支持度，过滤不可信的候选 token。在 MMHalSnowball 和 VisDiaHalBench 上，SGTD 在所测试的代表性 LVLM 中均在历史回答含有幻觉时取得最高准确率，同时保留了事实性上下文带来的收益。
key_points_zh: 核心问题：整体调节对话历史会同时影响有用事实和误导性回答，难以兼顾幻觉抑制与上下文利用。
定位与干预：通过同类型备选回答估计历史回答的视觉支持度，仅削弱低支持度内容的注意力影响。
三路解码：融合完整历史预测、选择性干预后的预测和不依赖历史回答的视觉证据，再依据视觉一致性和历史支持度筛选候选 token。
实验结果：在 MMHalSnowball 和 VisDiaHalBench 上，SGTD 在所测试的 LVLM 中均取得含幻觉历史条件下的最高准确率，同时保留事实性上下文的收益。
